summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The npm package `@servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-common@9.0.3` declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is written with hex-named identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and lookup-object string hiding to obscure literals such as `"ldd"`, `"/etc/os-release"`, and `"bun"`. At install time it downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it into a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable (mode 493 / 0755), and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The sibling file `math_init.js` is a single-line, approximately 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle exhibiting the obfuscator.io shape (rotated string array via push/shift, hex identifiers, no readable strings). Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at install time is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern, and is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a chat UI common library. The pattern is designed to evade Node-based scanners since the executed code runs under Bun rather than Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
